record.body:
## Rationale

The second shrinkage step was the executor brief omitting the work-item body. Original-text briefs carry record ids and quote Description/Approach and requirement text verbatim so the executor cannot inherit a shortened claim. execute-phase already forbids restating criterion; this phase extends that to the full claim chain and stops relying on criterion as the brief's lead claim.

## Counter-argument

A short agent-written summary in the assignment Orientation is easier to skim and fits small context windows. The cost is exactly the information loss that produced `status-tabs`: the summary becomes the de facto spec.

payload.alternatives: agent-written Orientation summary; brief lead with criterion
payload.choice: briefs carry record ids and quote original work-item and requirement text verbatim

record.subject: original-text-briefs
